mechanism: Tenofovir causes dose-dependent renal dysfunction and reduced glomerular filtration, impairing eplerenone clearance and increasing serum potassium levels; combined potassium-sparing effect increases hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antiretroviral therapy or reduce eplerenone dose; check potassium within 1 week of initiation and regularly thereafter.
